thread:
Maya: heads-up, getting a bunch of p95 pages for embed-service in us-west-2. looks like a traffic spike + a slow model variant.

incident-bot: ALERT p95_latency_embed_service_us-west-2 > 2200ms (5m) — paging oncall

pagerbot: page routed to primary: Devon, secondary: Priya

Devon: on it. grabbing traces now. are we seeing errors or pure latency?

Priya: I see 504 spikes around the same time in the logs, but most are just very slow completions (timeouts were at downstream). attaching quick log snippet:```
[2025-06-25T01:30:12Z] req_id=xyz latency=2350ms model=embed-v2 variant=quantized3
[2025-06-25T01:30:13Z] req_id=abc latency=2480ms model=embed-v2 variant=quantized3
```

Maya: thanks. traffic is from a partner batch job — they ramped from 10rps to 45rps in a minute per console.

Owen: if it's variant=quantized3, that variant got a kernel change in last deploy. can we route to embed-v2-standard?

Devon: trying a routing override now — switching canary -> standard for that partner. doing a quick test call...

Devon: test looks 600ms. traffic reroute live.

Maya: good. I'm going to propose temporary p95 threshold raise to avoid noisy pages while the partner backoff finishes. suggest p95 -> 3s for 30m. anyone opposed? we should document in the thread before making changes.

Priya: fine with 30m. want to ensure we're not masking real regressions. set a Jira ticket to track.

Owen: +1 30m, and add an automatic rollback at 30m. Also add a short note to the runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/embed-service#latency.

Maya: will do. changing alert:```bash
# temporary SLO override
redwood-alerts update p95_latency_embed_service_us-west-2 --threshold 3000 --duration 30m --comment "partner surge + variant reroute"
```

pagerbot: alert update applied by Maya — threshold now 3000ms for 30m.

Devon: monitoring. primary/secondary during this window: I'm primary, Priya secondary. I'll stay on standby until we confirm partner backoff.

Priya: noted. if latency doesn't drop under 900ms in 15m, we'll open a bridge and escalate to eng-runtime.

incident-bot: incident created INC-20250625-47: embed-service latency surge. Severity: SEV3.

Maya: Customer impact summary for the ticket: partner batch jobs experienced delayed embeddings leading to downstream pipeline lag (~5-10m delays). No customer-facing API errors reported directly; background ingestion only.

Owen: add this to the 'temporary-thresholds' section in the handoff notes so next oncall sees rationale.

Maya: handoff note appended: "175:30m override for partner surge after routing to standard variant reduced latency. follow-up: kernel revert investigation if regressions reappear."

Devon: 12m in — p95 is down to 850ms. error count back to baseline. partner confirmed they're throttling their ramp.

Priya: great. I'll cancel the automatic rollback? or let it expire?

Maya: let it expire — less chance to mismatch. I'll create a follow-up task: RDW-3567 to track the kernel change and run postmortem if needed.

Devon: closing notes for the thread: primary=Devon, secondary=Priya. temporary SLO raise applied 3000ms for 30m. routing override to embed-v2-standard applied. partner notified to throttle. monitor for 1hr.

Maya: thanks team. log this in the oncall spreadsheet and tag SRE lead for a quick review tomorrow. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: incident INC-20250625-47 status -> monitoring

Owen: small add — for future, add a short checklist in runbook for 'apply temporary threshold' with steps: check error type, confirm routing fallback, set auto-rollback, notify partner, create ticket. I'll PR a doc in docs/runbooks later.

Priya: all set from my side. I added a note in the runbook link above.

Maya: last check: anyone needs handoff? I'm handing to night rotation in 25m, Devon will escalate to the on-call if needed.

Devon: ready to accept handoff if anything pops after Maya leaves.

Maya: ok, marking this thread resolved for active paging; keeping the incident open for follow-up tasks.

incident-bot: INC-20250625-47 — updated severity to SEV3 (monitoring).

pagerbot: handoff log: from Maya to night-rotation via Devon (primary).
